title: Castle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-free castle on dark LED screen -->
  <!-- main keep body -->
  <rect x='30' y='42' width='40' height='45' fill='#b98a5e'/>
  <!-- lighter right face for depth -->
  <rect x='50' y='42' width='20' height='45' fill='#d9a878'/>
  <!-- brick rows -->
  <g stroke='#8a5a34' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'>
    <line x1='30' y1='52' x2='70' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='62' x2='70' y2='62'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='72' x2='70' y2='72'/>
    <line x1='40' y1='42' x2='40' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='60' y1='42' x2='60' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='35' y1='52' x2='35' y2='62'/>
    <line x1='55' y1='52' x2='55' y2='62'/>
    <line x1='45' y1='62' x2='45' y2='72'/>
    <line x1='65' y1='62' x2='65' y2='72'/>
    <line x1='38' y1='72' x2='38' y2='87'/>
    <line x1='62' y1='72' x2='62' y2='87'/>
  </g>
  <!-- battlements top of keep -->
  <g fill='#b98a5e'>
    <rect x='30' y='34' width='9' height='10'/>
    <rect x='45' y='34' width='9' height='10'/>
    <rect x='60' y='34' width='9' height='10'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#d9a878'>
    <rect x='60' y='34' width='9' height='10'/>
  </g>
  <!-- left tower -->
  <rect x='16' y='50' width='15' height='37' fill='#a87a50'/>
  <rect x='16' y='50' width='7' height='37' fill='#c39363'/>
  <!-- left tower battlements -->
  <g fill='#a87a50'>
    <rect x='16' y='42' width='5' height='9'/>
    <rect x='26' y='42' width='5' height='9'/>
  </g>
  <!-- left tower roof -->
  <polygon points='13,43 23.5,26 34,43' fill='#c0432f'/>
  <polygon points='23.5,26 34,43 23.5,43' fill='#e05a40'/>
  <!-- left tower window -->
  <rect x='20' y='58' width='7' height='10' rx='3.5' fill='#f7d94a'/>
  <!-- right tower -->
  <rect x='69' y='50' width='15' height='37' fill='#a87a50'/>
  <rect x='69' y='50' width='7' height='37' fill='#c39363'/>
  <g fill='#a87a50'>
    <rect x='69' y='42' width='5' height='9'/>
    <rect x='79' y='42' width='5' height='9'/>
  </g>
  <polygon points='66,43 76.5,26 87,43' fill='#c0432f'/>
  <polygon points='76.5,26 87,43 76.5,43' fill='#e05a40'/>
  <rect x='73' y='58' width='7' height='10' rx='3.5' fill='#f7d94a'/>
  <!-- smiling face on keep -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='57' r='3.5' fill='#2b2f8a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='57' r='3.5' fill='#2b2f8a'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='63' r='2.5' fill='#ff8a8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='63' r='2.5' fill='#ff8a8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 65 Q47.5 74 55 65' stroke='#2b2f8a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <path d='M43 87 L43 76 Q50 70 57 76 L57 87 Z' fill='#6b4428'/>
  <path d='M50 87 L50 75 Q53.5 73 57 76 L57 87 Z' fill='#845533'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='82' r='1.2' fill='#f7d94a'/>
  <!-- grass tufts at feet -->
  <g fill='#4fbf6a'>
    <path d='M14 87 Q16 82 18 87 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 87 Q82 82 84 87 Z'/>
    <path d='M25 89 Q27 85 29 89 Z'/>
    <path d='M68 89 Q70 85 72 89 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
